review.notes: Full review. Gate: residue=1 (anchor tag at README line 572), build passed (sorry only), depcheck 0 problems, no change outside the folder. Sources: OpenAI preprint fetched from the author's repository (SHA-256 matches the README), CN, AKT, DDT, Varma, ACC+, Conrad notes, Shepherd-Barron–Taylor (OCR) read at every sampled locator (0.2, 0.3, 1.3, 2.3, 3.1, 3.2, 4.2, 4.3, 5.2, 6.2, 7.2, 8.1, 8.4, 8.5, 8.6) and found to support the statements; Serre 1972 paywalled (uncertified), Le Hung draft not locatable. Adversarial table of 27 rows with computed values (worked examples recomputed numerically, including the F_7 counterexample to CN Lemma 5.6.5, recorded as a source error). Signatures elaborated and compared with the README; one-tactic padding probe closes nothing. Blocking: four CrystallineCM.* names and the rational seed contract's names/anchors do not exist at the suppliers' heads (supplier drift), and Serre's almost-all theorem is owned by both §5.1 and AdelicImagesAndModularCurves Layer 4 (two owners). P3: gate residue, backticked API names not in Suggested.lean, unresolvable Le Hung locator, abbreviated roadmap name, narrower residual hypothesis than CN 5.2, unused strength of 2 ≤ n.
